title: System Prompt Injection Severity Ladder: A Tiered Benchmark for Indirect Prompt Injection Attacks

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Severity tiering enables risk-proportionate evaluation and helps practitioners understand which attacks pose existential vs minor risks. Analogous to CVE severity in traditional security. Clear chain from measurement to risk-informed deployment decisions.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Designing a severity ladder is conceptually accessible, but testing prompt injection across tool-enabled agents requires setting up sandboxed tool environments. Running 30-50 scenarios against 3-4 agents with tools is moderately complex. Annotation requires security knowledge.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Design severity ladder + build benchmark + annotate outcomes + test across models = multiple deliverables. The severity ladder design alone could be a project. Scoping to 30 scenarios and 2 models would help but it is still multi-faceted.
